note: MAU2-CdLS7 cohort reports (18 individuals) describe variable penetrance of synophrys and thick eyebrows (around 9-12 of 18), supporting lower penetrance than classic NIPBL CdLS.

evidence.text: OMIM entry 621570 notes that facial features in MAU2 Cornelia de Lange syndrome 7 included thick eyebrows in 9 patients and synophrys.

evidence.text: Parenti et al. describe 18 individuals with heterozygous MAU2 variants exhibiting variable phenotypes from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with arched/thick eyebrows and synophrys observed.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: We describe 18 individuals carrying 15 heterozygous MAU2 variants and demonstrate pathogenicity through functional analyses. ... Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations
